# Chekki AI (채키 AI)

> Chekki AI is a homework and classroom automation platform for Korean families and English-language academies (hagwons, 어학원, 영어유치원). It has two products: a free/paid consumer app for parents and children (AI worksheet scanning, answer checking, pronunciation coaching), and a B2B academy platform that grades home scans against the class's real weekly answer key and turns Foreign Teacher (FT) class logs into Korean-language KakaoTalk parent updates, reviewed by a Korean Teacher (KT) before sending. Tagline: "채점은 채키가, 칭찬은 엄마가" (Grading by Chekki, praise by Mom).

## For families
- Parents photograph a child's completed paper worksheet; Chekki AI (Google Gemini multimodal OCR) grades it in under 5 seconds against any academy workbook or commercial publisher (Poly, GATE, PSA and others) without fixed templates or a manual answer key.
- Gives parents a Korean-language coaching script ("엄마, 이렇게 알려주세요"), so parents who aren't confident in English can still help.
- Wrong answers can be retried with a second-attempt rescan.
- Pronunciation coaching uses standard North American English text-to-speech and speech recognition calibrated for children's voices.
- Free tier: 3 scans/day. Pro tier: unlimited scans, a fraction of private tutoring cost.
- Ad-free, designed for children as young as 6. Kids work on paper; the phone is only used for a quick scan.
- Available on iOS (https://apps.apple.com/app/id6741479840), Android (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.chekkiai.app) and web.

## For academies (hagwons)
- Teachers upload the week's answer key once (scanned and OCR'd); every home scan is graded against it, so grading matches the academy's textbook rather than an AI guess.
- Parent mistakes at home show up on the teacher dashboard before the next class.
- Foreign Teacher (FT) logs a class session in under 30 seconds.
- Korean Teacher (KT) reviews an AI-drafted Korean KakaoTalk parent update before it's sent — human-in-the-loop, no auto-send.
- Printable review sheets from each student's wrong answers, and academy-branded report cards.
- Directors get an aggregate dashboard across classes and teachers.
- Plans: 7-day free academy trial, solo tutor / study room, starter academy, School Pro, large academy and franchise.
